column3: The Hebrew title is only “Of David”; NASB sets “A Psalm of David” in braces before verse 1. “My desire” (soul) is rendered “my soul.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in vain” is rendered “without cause.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalties” is rendered “lovingkindnesses.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in good” is rendered “in prosperity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the counsel of the LORD” is rendered “The secret of the LORD.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they have made wide” is rendered “are enlarged.”
